dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem a bit worse for wear.

dialogues.speaker: Allan
dialogues.text: Oh I'm fine... It's just, I got a bit lost yesterday when I was out hunting...

dialogues.speaker: Allan
dialogues.text: I almost wound up in a hilichurl camp. Fortunately I managed to escape...

response.speaker: Allan
response.text: I'm lucky I made it back safe and sound. But once again, I came back empty-handed...

response.speaker: Allan
response.text: But... *sigh* Never mind. It is what it is.

response.speaker: Allan
response.text: I'm alright, really. I just always end up getting rescued by Outrider Amber...

response.speaker: Allan
response.text: She's quite the capable one. Well, she is a Vision bearer after all.
